name: Aircraft - Improve Model in Right-click Menu
description: Adds Improve aircraft model... to the native Aircraft types right-click menu. Uses the original request dialog and both priority choices, with the selected aircraft role fixed. The game creates a named successor of the selected player model, applies native priority adjustments, and schedules it as a normal saved prototype with native development time plus the request delay. Current aircraft remain usable. Unavailable for foreign, obsolete, developing, superseded or final-version models, or while another aircraft request is pending. Native research and manufacturer checks still apply. Restart through Play with mods. Experimental; see Mods/Manager/AIRCRAFT_IMPROVEMENTS.md for validation scope.
